title: Trivance: Latency-Optimal AllReduce by Shortcutting Multiport Networks
authors: Anton Juerss, Vamsi Addanki, Stefan Schmid
affiliations: Weizenbaum Institute, TU Berlin, Purdue University
research_focus: Datacenter networking, Collective communication, Distributed training

problem_statement.en: Collective startup steps, routed distance and link congestion interact: using both ports can reduce the step count while full vectors increase transmitted bytes.
problem_statement.zh: Collective startup step、route distance 與 link congestion 相互影響；同時使用雙 port 可減少 step，full-vector 傳輸增加 byte 量。

key_innovation.en: Each rank communicates simultaneously with peers at ±3^k distance and jointly reduces two incoming messages. A latency variant forwards full vectors in one phase; a bandwidth variant runs ReduceScatter then reverse AllGather with shrinking/growing blocks. Generalization handles arbitrary sizes and parallel dimensions.
key_innovation.zh: 各 rank 同時與 ±3^k 距離的 peer 通訊，joint reduction 合併兩份 incoming message。Latency variant 單階段傳 full vector；bandwidth variant 先 ReduceScatter 再反向 AllGather，縮小／放大 block。設計擴展至任意規模與多維度。

key_improvements.en: Trivance improves latency-bound completion by 5–30%; the advantage extends through 512 KiB in rings, 8 MiB in multidimensional tori, and 32 MiB in high-bandwidth examples. Some 3D cases improve up to 20% through 128 MiB. §6.2 identifies crossover to Swing around 8 MiB in rectangular tori.
key_improvements.zh: Latency-bound 完成時間改善 5–30%；優勢延伸至 ring 的 512 KiB、多維 torus 的 8 MiB、高 bandwidth 情境的 32 MiB。部分 3D 情境在 128 MiB 內改善最高 20%。§6.2 的 rectangular torus 約於 8 MiB 轉向 Swing。
